items.title: Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, arrested after feds find sexually explicit photos of him with minors, DOJ says
items.brief: Thomas Markle , the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex , was arrested Friday morning by federal agents in Florida on charges related to child sexual abuse material, the Department of Justice announced Friday.

items.title: Three Justice Department officials, including man behind Trump’s ‘grand conspiracy’ probe, resign since brutal midterm losses
items.brief: Jason Reding Quiñones, the senior federal prosecutor who led a sprawling investigation into President Donald Trump’s political foes, has resigned from the Justice Department.

items.title: Jay Rockefeller, former West Virginia governor and US senator who was part of a dynasty, dies at 89
items.brief: Jay Rockefeller, the last member of his family’s political dynasty — and the only Democrat — who served as West Virginia’s governor and later a longtime US senator, has died.

items.title: Market turmoil saps enthusiasm for the buzziest IPO of the year
items.brief: Anthropic couldn’t have picked a worse time to pull off the biggest IPO the world has ever seen.

items.title: Tesla set to wind down production of Cybertruck
items.brief: It looks like the end of the road for the Cybertruck.

items.title: The US economy added 165,000 jobs in October and the unemployment rate fell
items.brief: Job growth surpassed expectations in October, new data showed Friday, with the US economy adding 165,000 jobs.

items.title: AI stocks bounce back after $2.5 trillion wipe out
items.brief: An AI-driven stock sell-off that wiped roughly $2.5 trillion in market value off Wall Street eased on Friday, but only after hitting Asian and European markets hard.
